caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a weathered, metallic-looking cow weathervane mounted on a horizontal rod. The cow is oriented facing to the right, with visible horns, ears, and an udder. The body of the cow is rendered in shades of brown with patches and streaks of rust, yellow, and blue-green, giving it an aged, patina-like appearance. The cow's face and horns are darker, with more grayish-blue tones. The rod on which the cow stands is cylindrical, colored in shades of black and blue-gray, and runs horizontally across the lower part of the drawing, with a short vertical support in the center. The background is a plain, light beige color. The artist's signature, "Beverly Chichester," appears near the bottom right, with numerical notations "175" and "p. 79" nearby.
title: Cow Weather Vane
